title: Ezra Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Ezra 1: Cyrus king of Persia lets the exiles go up to rebuild Yahweh's house in Jerusalem.

questions.text: In which year of Cyrus king of Persia did he make his proclamation?
questions.explanation: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, Yahweh stirred up his spirit, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom.

questions.text: Whose mouth had spoken the word of Yahweh that was now being accomplished?
questions.explanation: The proclamation came so that Yahweh's word by Jeremiah's mouth might be accomplished.

questions.text: What did Cyrus say Yahweh, the God of heaven, had given him?
questions.explanation: Cyrus said, "Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth."

answers.text: All the kingdoms of the earth
A son to rule after him

questions.text: Where did Cyrus say Yahweh had commanded him to build a house?
questions.explanation: Cyrus said Yahweh had commanded him to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

answers.text: In Babylon, the city of the king
In Susa, the royal city of Persia
In Samaria, in the land of Israel
In Jerusalem, which is in Judah

questions.text: With what were the men of each place to help those who went up?
questions.explanation: Cyrus said the men of each place should help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals.

questions.text: The heads of fathers' households of which tribes rose up to build Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: The heads of fathers' households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests, and the Levites rose up to build Yahweh's house in Jerusalem.

questions.text: Who had brought the vessels of Yahweh's house out of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Cyrus brought out the vessels of Yahweh's house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem and put in the house of his gods.

questions.text: By whose hand did Cyrus bring out the vessels?
questions.explanation: Cyrus king of Persia brought them out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer.

questions.text: To whom were the vessels counted out?
questions.explanation: The vessels were counted out to Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

questions.text: How many vessels of gold and of silver were there in all?
questions.explanation: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred.
